summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py and added tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when a stored term URI equals the reference under node-type-aware equality, so container properties like rdf:_1 are False and plain strings and Literals are False. _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). New tests cover prefix membership (positive, proper-prefix negative, self), SH, RDFS closed membership (positive, undefined-term negative, string and Literal negatives), and RDF closed membership (rdf:type True, rdf:_1 False). Tests and doctests were not run, per the instructions; the work was verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
